Title: Register with valid details and land on login
Steps: 1. Open /auth/register 2. Enter Tushaar Gupta + unique email + Valid#12345 3. Submit
ExpectedResult: User is redirected to login page

Title: Login verify profile then logout clears session
Steps: 1. Login with registered credentials 2. Open Account > Profile 3. Check first name last name email 4. Open nav menu > Sign out 5. Attempt /account/profile
ExpectedResult: Profile shows Tushaar Gupta and registered email; after Sign out user is on login and profile redirects to login

Title: Multi-item cart quantity update then CoD confirm×2 shows INV invoice
Steps: 1. Add 2+ products 2. Open cart 3. Increase qty on one line and verify total changes 4. Proceed cart → sign-in → address → payment 5. Cash on Delivery 6. Confirm twice 7. Note invoice number format 8. Open My Invoices
ExpectedResult: Cart total recalculates; invoice number matches INV-<year><seq>; invoice listed under My Invoices

Title: Register with already-used email is rejected
Steps: 1. Open register 2. Submit form using existing email
ExpectedResult: Error shown; user not registered again

Title: Checkout blocked with incomplete billing address
Steps: 1. Clear/edit street city postal house to empty 2. Observe Proceed to payment
ExpectedResult: Proceed stays disabled; payment step not reached

Title: Single Confirm does not generate invoice yet
Preconditions: Logged-in user at payment CoD step
Steps: 1. Select Cash on Delivery 2. Click Confirm once only 3. Check payment page and My Invoices
ExpectedResult: Payment success may show; no invoice number; My Invoices still empty

Title: API register login token create cart then logout
Steps: 1. POST /users/register 2. POST /users/login 3. POST /carts with Bearer token 4. GET /users/me 5. GET /users/logout 6. GET /users/me again
ExpectedResult: 201/200; access_token; cart id; me 200 before logout; me ≥401 after logout

Title: API add product generate invoice and GET detail
Steps: 1. GET /products 2. Add product 3. GET cart assert cart_items 4. POST /invoices with guide payload 5. GET /invoices/{id}
ExpectedResult: cart_items length > 0; invoice id; detail has invoicelines; billing matches fixture; invoice_number INV-<year><seq>; total > 0
